title: Islamic History (Heritage) Month 2026
body:
Islamic History (Heritage) Month 2026
By
City of Waterloo
-
Oct 01, 2026
City news
For generations, Muslim residents have helped shape our community through leadership, creativity, service and commitment to making Waterloo a welcoming place for all. Mosques, community organizations and cultural spaces continue to foster connection, belonging and mutual support while enriching the social fabric of our city.
This month, we recognize the many contributions of Muslim communities, past and present, and celebrate the diversity, perspectives and experiences that help make Waterloo a stronger and more vibrant community.
